What every prophet taught

One worship, sincere to God

Prayer, bowing and giving run through the lives of the prophets, all of it sincerely for God.

God tells Moses in the Quran: worship Me and keep up the prayer. Abraham asks to keep it, and for some of his descendants too. Ishmael urged it on his family, Jesus was charged with it, and Isaac and Jacob were inspired to it, along with giving. The books below show people bowing before God. Rites can vary from people to people. What stays one is sincerity in worship: all of it for God alone.

﴿إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, I am Allāh. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.

Quran · Ta-Ha 20:14

﴿رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

Quran · Ibrahim 14:40

﴿وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by Him].

Quran · Maryam 19:55

﴿وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَـٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive

Quran · Maryam 19:31

﴿وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:73

﴿وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And they were not commanded except to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakāh. And that is the correct religion.

Quran · Al-Bayyinah 98:5

You might ask

QuestionDid earlier peoples also pray and bow?
AnswerThe Quran says so. It tells the Children of Israel to keep up prayer, give, and bow with those who bow. It does not claim every form was the same.Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:43
QuestionWhat is sincerity in worship?
AnswerGiving your worship to God alone, from the heart, with no show. The Quran says people were commanded this, with prayer and giving, and calls it the upright religion.Quran · Al-Bayyinah 98:5
QuestionDo I need a special place to pray?
AnswerPrayer can begin at home. The Quran tells Moses and his brother to settle their people, make their homes places of prayer, and keep up the prayer.Quran · Yunus 10:87

Give God your prayer, sincerely, with your whole heart.
